source: claude-code subagent (viewed all 4 contact sheets + profile + transcript (auto-captions, 811 cues))
summary: Vlog 60 of the 'Zero to £100M' series, titled as 'The Reality of Buying a $10M Business in London'. Over two nights in London it moves through an airport arrival, a back-seat car conversation, a meeting with a young co-founder of an M&A simulator game, a UK investor-visa event in Parliament, an Airbnb, a kitchen piece to camera pitching his coaching community, and a live deal completion on a video call ('Fuck, we just bought a new company'). After the 'NEXT RELEASE' card, about 10 minutes of bonus screen-recorded demo of the simulator follow. It is the darkest, most low-key grade (53% low-key frames) and has the densest speech (178 wpm, 98% coverage).
hook_analysis: A music-led cold open. A rap track (its lyrics appear in the auto-captions) plays over a dark car interior with a white stat overlay, 'VLOG 60 / CURRENT REVENUE: £9M' (0:00). City b-roll with a Rolls-Royce and a cyclist (0:10) follows, then the 'ZERO TO £100M' card (0:20). At 0:26 speech starts ('Just landed in London') with the setup: a board meeting and a deal due to close. The revenue counter frames the series' progress metric before anything else.
narrative_arc: Setup (close the deal today) comes at 1:29. Then: a car ride and the video-game launch (1:59-4:27); meeting the co-founder (5:17-7:55); the Parliament/investor-visa event (8:05-10:04); the Airbnb and a friend (10:14-11:33); the coaching pitch in the kitchen (11:43-14:22); the simulator explained to an older guest (14:32-16:01); and the climax, a video-call completion and reaction (16:11-18:59). Outro card at 19:19, then the bonus demo (19:29-29:43). It is a clear setup-to-payoff arc, with the payoff saved for the end.
camera_and_composition: Handheld, often low-light. Airport selfie medium close-ups (0:30-1:29). A back-seat car shot from the opposite seat with a wide lens (1:59-4:27). Over-the-table restaurant shots against a window, with a dark foreground (5:17-7:46). Landmark cutaways (Big Ben 8:05, London Eye 8:45). Chandelier/light-fixture details (10:14-10:24). A kitchen piece to camera at counter height (11:53-14:22). Silhouette against net curtains for the deal call (16:11-16:41). Screen recording fills the frame in the bonus section. Exact moves are not observable at storyboard resolution.
color_and_grade: Very warm, dim amber tungsten interiors (palette #241710, #60390c) with deep shadows. Daytime London exteriors are cool and grey for contrast. The bonus section is a blue/purple UI screen. A small amount of letterboxing is detected (10.5%). Overall it is the most 'night-time intimate' look in the set.
sound_and_music: From auto-captions: near-continuous speech (98% coverage, 178 wpm). Thirteen [music] markers, including a rap track with captioned lyrics over the 0:00-0:22 cold open and music under the Parliament event intro (~4:36-4:57). Laughter markers (9) and one [applause] at the deal completion (~16:41). There is strong profanity in speech. The music cannot be identified beyond the caption markers.
what_to_borrow: A running metric overlay ('CURRENT REVENUE') in the first frame to anchor a series' progress
State the episode's goal early ('we're supposed to close today') and pay it off on camera at the end
Name lower-thirds for notable people at events
Contrast cool, grey exteriors with warm tungsten interiors to separate public and private moments
Film the real reaction live after a milestone call instead of re-staging it
what_to_avoid_copying: 'ZERO TO £100M' card, 'VLOG 60 / CURRENT REVENUE' counter format and 'NEXT RELEASE' card (series branding)
The 10-minute bonus product demo appended after the outro, which is advertising
Licensed rap track and heavy profanity in the cold open
Underexposed interiors where faces fall into black (19:09)
